dog.description_text: Meet Audi, a handsome German Shepherd boy with a loyal heart and a playful spirit! Audi loves car rides and is always happy to hop in for an adventure. He knows the cues sit and lie down and enjoys playing with a ball, especially when it involves a good game of throw and fetch. His previous owner's favorite thing about him was how loyal he is-a wonderful quality that makes Audi a special companion. If you're looking for a handsome, loyal boy who loves adventures and playing fetch, Audi may be the perfect match for you!
dog.name: Audi
